# lamplighter

> Agent memory as one binary. `lampl` stores an agent's decisions, root causes and gotchas, recalls them with hybrid full-text and vector search behind a calibrated relevance floor, and reaches the
agent through Claude Code hooks, a CLI and an MCP server. Apache-2.0, Rust, no LLM key required. Modes: embedded SQLite, `lampl serve` on Postgres with pgvector, external Postgres, Docker.

Memory types: fact, decision, problem, fix, procedure, gotcha. Link types: SUPERSEDES, SOLVES, CAUSES, CONTRADICTS. Embedded mode supports store and recall only; links, audit, export and import need a
server. Recall may return nothing by design.
